description: This file contains utility functions in the GuzzleHttp PSR7 package, providing stream manipulation, request modification, URI handling, and other helpers.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for stream and request manipulation, URI redaction, and miscellaneous helpers within the GuzzleHttp PSR7 package.

methods.name: caselessRemove
methods.description: Removes items from data array matching keys list case-insensitively.

methods.name: copyToStream
methods.description: Copies data from a source stream into a destination stream up to a maximum length.

methods.name: copyToString
methods.description: Reads data from a stream into a string up to a maximum length.

methods.name: hash
methods.description: Calculates a hash value for the contents of a stream.

methods.name: modifyRequest
methods.description: Creates a clone of a request with specified modifications such as method, headers, body, URI, etc.

methods.name: readLine
methods.description: Reads a line from a stream up to a maximum length.

methods.name: redactUserInfo
methods.description: Redacts the password portion in the user info of a URI.

methods.name: streamFor
methods.description: Creates a StreamInterface object from various resource, string, iterator, or callable inputs.

methods.name: tryFopen
methods.description: Safely opens a file stream and throws an exception on failure.

methods.name: tryGetContents
methods.description: Safely reads the entire contents of a stream and throws on error.

methods.name: uriFor
methods.description: Converts a string or UriInterface into a UriInterface object.
